hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A letter is special only if every lowercase appearance occurs strictly before the first uppercase appearance.

hints.title: Index Tracking
hints.text: Record the last index where each lowercase letter appears, and the first index where each uppercase letter appears.

hints.title: Condition Verification
hints.text: For each letter from a to z, check if both cases exist and whether the last lowercase index is strictly smaller than the first uppercase index.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass collecting extreme positions for 26 alphabetic characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string scans on each character encounter take quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using 26-element integer arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track extreme boundary indices rather than full occurrence lists.
